copy.tagline: 集成并管理 Firebase 云消息推送
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的应用需要接入 Firebase 推送通知。
copy.tagline_en: Set up and manage Firebase Cloud Messaging for push notifications.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Firebase push notifications into your app.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会指导你完成Firebase Cloud Messaging在Flutter项目中的配置，包括权限申请、token管理、前后台消息处理、以及服务端消息发送（HTTP v1）。
howto.when: 当你需要为Flutter应用设置推送通知，或询问FCM配置、消息处理、权限等时，触发此技能。

say.note: 会获得完整的配置指南。
会说明后台消息处理写法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through configuring Firebase Cloud Messaging in a Flutter project, including permission requests, token management, foreground/background message handling, and server-side message dispatch via HTTP v1.
howto.when_en: This skill is triggered when you need to set up push notifications in Flutter, or ask about FCM configuration, message handling, permissions, token management, etc.
